Gavinana — Florence, Italy

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Gavinana sits in Quartiere 3 (Gavinana-Galluzzo), which multiple reports based on Fondazione Caponnetto data identify as by far the safest of Florence's five administrative districts (around 8 recorded microcrime episodes over six months, versus well over 400 in the historic centre). One district crime summary did flag Piazza Elia Costa specifically for gang activity requiring monitoring, but overall this remains a low-crime, mostly residential area. Sources checked: La Nazione, Fondazione Caponnetto six-month microcrime report; La Firenze che Vorrei, quartiere-by-quartiere summer crime report (Quartiere 3 data).

Frequently asked questions

Is Gavinana safe?

Wandroz currently rates Gavinana in Florence as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Florence during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Florence at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Florence publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Gavinana safe at night?

At night, Gavinana is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Florence. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Gavinana a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Gavinana's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Florence) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for Gavinana?
